load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint from a file path onto a specified CPU or CUDA device
save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model state dictionary to a checkpoint file in the specified folder
convert_to_one_hot: convert a tensor of target class indices into a one-hot encoded tensor given the number of classes
recursive_copy_to_device: recursively copy tensors inside nested lists, tuples, and dicts to a specified PyTorch device
split_batchnorm_params: split a model parameters into BatchNorm parameters and all other parameters for separate optimization
